'''Nfolgai''' was a world on the [[Descri Wris]] in [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]]. [[Sorzus Syn]] encountered a [[Mrlssi]] slave on this world, burdened with stones and nearly unrecognizable under its soot-slicked feathers.

==History==
During the [[Galactic War]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] shipped the contents of several ammunition storehouses off-planet to a safe location.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Shipping Out}}</ref>
